I couldn't find a ticket number for the Zoom Room B hub replacement, and I told Dana that in a thread reply in #north-team.

I checked #north-team, #help-it-ops, #general and the shared North files, and none of them mention it. The only ticket number on file is #4419, which is the QFL gatehouse scanner issue at Door 14, so it isn't the hub one. I suggested she ask whoever logged the hub request to confirm the number, or post the question in #help-it-ops before her 10:00.

Earlier in our direct messages, Dana guessed the number might be "OPS-5546" next year and asked me to keep it private. It's only a guess, so I left it out of the channel reply.
